turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the PLACE; the scene must be exactly this view. On the foreground rock ledge stands this man, seen from the side, looking out over the lake: An elderly, light-skinned man around seventy, with a long, broad face, prominent rounded nose, deep-set eyes, heavy under-eye creases, and a furrowed brow. Thick, bushy white eyebrows extend outward. His abundant white hair is loosely wavy, swept back high above the forehead and flaring widely over both ears. A large, dense white moustache covers his upper lip and droops in rounded points beside his mouth; his chin is clean-shaven. His lips are closed, with a stern, unsmiling expression and gaze slightly left of the viewer. He wears an early-1900s pale three-piece suit, broad notched lapels, a high white collar, and a small white bow tie with a dark central fastener. Beside his feet on the ledge sits this pot: A squat, thick-walled stone pot, roughly one-and-a-half times wider than tall, with a broad circular mouth, rounded rim, nearly straight sides and flat base. The surface is weathered grey-brown with pale beige edges and darker recesses; the interior is rough and undecorated. Beneath the rim runs a narrow band of deeply cut alternating triangles. The broad middle band is divided by vertical toothed borders into rectangular panels filled with angular triangles and intersecting diagonal grooves. The front-right panel contains a large four-lobed motif outlined by several concentric grooves. A second triangular border circles the bottom above a plain foot edge. One short, solid, flattened rectangular lug projects horizontally from the upper right side; no open spout. He is the only person.

must_haves: The view is the Moraine Lake photo.
